properties.name: Finite nonempty model domain
properties.description: Finite nonempty operational/output spaces and the declared admissible label domains; claims are scoped to this model.

properties.name: Operational state sufficiency
properties.description: All state relevant to each declared kernel is included or history-conditioned; canonical snapshot alone is not presumed Markov.

properties.name: Admissibility and complete input labels
properties.description: Allowed Step and qualified Learn domains agree on projection fibers, or rejection is observable; merged input labels need joint state-input fiber consistency.

properties.name: Explicit state and output projections
properties.description: Surjective q on operational states and explicit output map r; role, reference, evidence and lineage preservation claims need corresponding observations.

properties.name: Normalized stochastic kernels
properties.description: Every defined Step/Learn kernel is nonnegative with total mass one; external outcome generation remains a separately specified law.

properties.name: Exact Step and Learn quotient criterion
properties.description: Under A1-A5, exact macro Step and Learn kernels exist iff their respective pushed-forward laws are constant on every q-fiber for every admissible full input.
properties.source_section: P1. 전이와 학습을 보존하는 정확한 요약의 필요충분조건

properties.name: Analytic proof of P1
properties.description: Necessity: identical macro inputs imply identical laws. Sufficiency: choose a representative of each fiber and use its pushed-forward kernel; fiber constancy gives representative independence and normalization is preserved.
properties.source_section: P1. 전이와 학습을 보존하는 정확한 요약의 필요충분조건

properties.name: Noninjective summary cannot decode a lost distinction
properties.description: If a declared summary agrees on two states but an admissible target output law differs, no decoder reading only that summary reproduces both.
properties.source_section: P2. 같은 점수로 뭉개진 차이는 그 점수만 읽어 복원할 수 없다

properties.name: Analytic proof of P2
properties.description: The decoder receives equal inputs and hence has one output law, contradicting the required unequal laws. Arbitrary scalar encodings are not excluded.
properties.source_section: P2. 같은 점수로 뭉개진 차이는 그 점수만 읽어 복원할 수 없다

properties.name: Observational law need not identify causal effect
properties.description: Two structural models can agree on the full observed joint distribution and disagree under the same do intervention.
properties.source_section: P3. 관찰에서 같아도 원인은 다를 수 있다

properties.name: Analytic proof of P3
properties.description: M1: A is an exogenous fair bit and Y=A. M2: Y is exogenous fair and A=Y. Both observe equal fair bits; do(A=0) yields Y=0 in M1 and fair Y in M2.
properties.source_section: P3. 관찰에서 같아도 원인은 다를 수 있다

properties.name: Child marginal kernels do not determine composition
properties.description: The same two child marginal laws can yield different composite output laws under different couplings.
properties.source_section: P4. 하위의 주변분포만으로 상위 결합을 결정할 수 없다

properties.name: Analytic proof of P4
properties.description: For fair bits A,B, independent coupling gives XOR=1 with probability 1/2; common-noise A=B gives probability zero. Marginals agree in both cases.
properties.source_section: P4. 하위의 주변분포만으로 상위 결합을 결정할 수 없다

properties.name: Compatible role-equivariant maps compose
properties.description: Given compatible input/intermediate/output group actions, the composition of equivariant typed maps is equivariant; role swaps are not automatically group elements.
properties.source_section: P5. 역할 내부 순열 불변성과 역할 교환은 다르다

properties.name: Analytic proof of P5
properties.description: For deterministic maps, f(h(gx))=f(g h(x))=g f(h(x)). For finite kernels, reindex the intermediate summation. This proves symmetry preservation only.
properties.source_section: P5. 역할 내부 순열 불변성과 역할 교환은 다르다

properties.name: Equal prediction means, different learning state
properties.description: Scalar Gaussian mean 0 with variance 1 or 4; after Env supplies y=1 with H=R=1, the chosen Learn update produces means 1/2 and 4/5. q(m,P)=m loses the needed distinction.

properties.name: Role-erasing sum loses directional transport
properties.description: source=1,target=0 and source=0,target=1 have equal role-blind sum but source-to-target messages differ.

properties.name: Equal observations, different interventions
properties.description: A=Y fair observationally can arise from A causes Y or Y causes A, with different do(A=0) outcomes.

properties.name: Shared noise changes composite XOR
properties.description: Equal Bernoulli(1/2) child marginals allow independent or identical shared-noise outputs and different XOR laws.

properties.name: Role swap is not within-role enumeration
properties.description: Exchanging source and target changes transport meaning; merely reordering incidence enumeration within an unordered role does not.

properties.name: Coherent transport with wrong external reference
properties.description: A correctly processed sensor is interpreted as a different room sensor. Algebraic consistency does not validate its external referent. Accessible provenance/measurements and reference-substitution controls are needed.

properties.name: Deep Sets
properties.description: Sum of learned features can preserve permutation invariance; theorem domains and role-preserving symmetry must be specified. No grounding or optimizer guarantee.
properties.read_depth: Primary PDF sections 2.1-3.1, Theorem 2 and equivariance construction

properties.name: On the Limitations of Representing Functions on Sets
properties.description: Continuous sum-decompositions have latent-dimension constraints for universal set-function representation; particular simple functions may need less. Not a bound for all neural architectures.
properties.read_depth: Primary PDF Theorem 4.1 proof and 4.1 discussion, fixed/bounded cardinality conditions

properties.name: A synthetic approach to Markov kernels, conditional independence and theorems on sufficient statistics
properties.description: General language for stochastic composition and conditional independence; no HSWM theorem adopted from this source.
properties.read_depth: Primary abstract, version and journal record only; not a full theorem audit

properties.name: Deep Sets / role-aware transport
properties.description: Deep Sets / role-aware transport
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Specify grounding, role group, recipient outputs, arity and representation capacity. Raw pooling and learned role-wise feature sums are different.

properties.name: Hopfield / attention / sparse retrieval
properties.description: Hopfield / attention / sparse retrieval
properties.usable_operation: Conditional retrieval and context-dependent message selection.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Preserve selected/omitted evidence and roles; attention concentration is not identified causal credit.

properties.name: Delta rule / TTT / GDN
properties.description: Delta rule / TTT / GDN
properties.usable_operation: Residual-driven numerical updates for an explicitly defined observed variable and loss.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Need operational variables, reset/persistence contract and independent causal identification; nonconvex/topology-changing learning is not covered by generic OCO convergence claims.

properties.name: Kalman / KDN uncertainty
properties.description: Kalman / KDN uncertainty
properties.usable_operation: Mean/covariance update under a stated probabilistic model.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Need justified model/noise and calibration, plus retained state sufficient for the next update; token-derived covariance is not scientific claim reliability.

properties.name: Nested Learning / multiple update timescales
properties.description: Nested Learning / multiple update timescales
properties.usable_operation: Different update frequencies and retention horizons.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Specify actual state, lineage, exceptions and qualified revisions; scheduling alone does not give causal or compositional learning.

properties.name: Low-rank / MLA / spectral compression
properties.description: Low-rank / MLA / spectral compression
properties.usable_operation: Low-rank or spectral projections of a declared numerical representation.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Reconstruction error alone does not bound allowed-intervention or Learn error; retain or bound reference/role/exception loss.

properties.name: Causal abstraction / open stochastic composition
properties.description: Causal abstraction / open stochastic composition
properties.usable_operation: Explicit state/intervention maps, conditional coupling and composition of kernels.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Need Step, Learn and Env commutation plus lineage/rights/restore separately; no independence or beneficial learning follows from wiring.

properties.name: mHC / recurrence / small-gain
properties.description: mHC / recurrence / small-gain
properties.usable_operation: Constrained mixing, repeated state use and stability analysis under named premises.
properties.unmet_hswm_premise: Matrix closure, boundedness and representability do not imply grounding, exception preservation, update commutation or scale learning.
